paper.title_en: Searches for the Tensor Glueball in ψ(3686) Radiative Decays at BESIII
paper.abstract_en: Search for bound states of gluons-glueballs-remains one of the most important challenges of the modern QCD. Notable progress in this task has been achieved in various studies of $J{\text{/}}\psi $ decays performed by the BESIII Collaboration. In this paper we present overview of the BESIII glueball search program. Preliminary results of one such study, radiative $\psi (3686)$ decays into ${{\pi }^{0}}{{\pi }^{0}}$ system, are shown as well.
